ns2:section.sectionText: ***When classes begin, you will need to receive department approval to be added prior to the first class meeting. No approvals will be granted following the first meeting: econug@illinois.edu*** Enrollment limited to undergraduate Economics majors only. Approved for S/U grading only. This class meets the following dates: January 25 (152 Wohlers), February 15 (120 ARCH), March 29 (120 ARCH), and April 19 (120 ARCH). **Please note the first class meeting the two sections will meet separately, then with combine for the remaining dates and classrooms will change.** Outside work will be assigned during the weeks this class does not meet.
